crossRefs.note: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before…

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Son of Abiathar the priest during David's reign

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord king David has made Solomon king.
translations.bsb: “Not at all,” Jonathan replied. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
translations.kjv: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
translations.asv: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king:
